summary: Backend regression for iteration-3 card-games upgrade pack: validated all 10 new endpoints (5 Blackjack /sidebet, /split, /surrender, /active-hand, /bonus-buy + 5 Poker mode-B /start-mode-b, /post-blinds, /seat/<token>/bet, /round-state, /auto-settle), the /static/js/card_renderer.js asset, and the Monte Carlo artifact. 27/27 pytest cases passed against the live Flask app on port 5000. Smoke-test reference (/app/scripts/smoke_test_iter3.py) also passed end-to-end. Monte Carlo simulator (--hands 100000 --rake 0.0886) reports observed_rtp = 94.80%, inside the 94.5–95.5% acceptance band specified in the agent_to_agent_context_note (100k variance ≈ ±0.4%).

minor.issue: Script reports `within_tolerance=false` because its internal target_tolerance_pct is 0.1% while observed_rtp drifts ~0.2% below 95% on a 100k run. Per task spec (94.5–95.5% band) this is acceptable, but the rake constant 0.0886 yields a slight bias. Consider raising the script's tolerance to ±0.5% or recalibrating to ~0.0830 for a 100k run to land closer to 95.00%.

action_items: Optional: tweak Monte Carlo target tolerance or rake constant so within_tolerance=true on 100k hands. Current observed_rtp 94.80% is within the 94.5–95.5% acceptance band documented for this iteration.
Long-term maintainability: /app/app.py is now ~3200 lines (>700 line guideline). Consider splitting blackjack/poker/poker-mode-B endpoints into Flask blueprints under /app/api/.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/app.py reached ~3200 lines — past the 700-line guideline; iteration-3 endpoints sit at L2486–3199. Refactor into blueprints (blackjack, poker_mode_b, points) recommended before iteration-4.

Bonus-buy: smoke test asserts payout_pts==250 for bet=100 (3:2 BJ payout = bet+1.5*bet = 250) which matches /start logic; the inline doc-comment 'forces natural BJ → 6:5 payout' is misleading. Recommend updating the docstring to reflect 3:2 (matches existing BJ rules).
Surrender endpoint accepts dealer up 9-A (rank values 9..14); contract now enforced; covered by tests.
/api/poker/seat/<token>/bet has no global rate-limit; large numbers of malformed bodies could be sent. Mode-B is operator-supervised so low risk, but worth noting.

card_renderer.js exposes via `global.CardRenderer` (line 338); browser load works because UMD wrapper assigns to window. Verified 200 over /static, balanced braces, and methods drawCard/drawChip/drawChipStack/animateCardFlip present.

success_rate.backend: 100% (27/27 pytest passed in iter8_results.xml; smoke_test_iter3.py also green)

test_credentials: None — all tests create disposable TEST_iter8_* players via POST /api/players and seed 200000 pts via SQLite UPDATE on /app/casino.db.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates fresh player rows (TEST_iter8_<ts>_<rand>) and seeds points directly. bonus_buy_log rows are created by the bonus-buy tests; the session-limit test back-dates them via SQL to bypass cooldown without altering production data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 iter-3 endpoints validated against live app on http://localhost:5000 (NOT 8001). Pytest entrypoint: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_card_games.py -v`. Monte Carlo invocation: `python /app/scripts/blackjack_montecarlo_95.py --hands 100000 --rake 0.0886` (writes /app/scripts/bj_montecarlo_report.json with key `observed_rtp`). Split-pair happy path is probabilistic (~6% chance per deal) — test loops up to 30 deals and pytest.skips if no pair surfaces. Bonus-buy session-cap test back-dates bonus_buy_log to bypass 120s cooldown.
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced. Initial pytest failure on Monte Carlo test was a test-side key mismatch (script writes `observed_rtp`, test read `rtp`) — fixed in test file by checking both keys. All 27 cases now green.
